results.title: Alex Eala returns to US Open a different version of herself
results.description: Alex Eala made her US Open debut with little expectation. She returns with expectations of making a deep run.

results.title: Zepeda Doubts Mason Would Last 12 Rounds With Him
results.description: WBC lightweight champion William Zepeda has his sights set on a unification bout with WBO titleholder Abdullah Mason but believes the 22-year-old would struggle to hear the final bell against him.

results.title: Valkyries halt cold-shooting Lynx's 6-game winning streak
results.description: (Photo credit: Jesse Johnson-Imagn Images) Cecilia Zandalasini scored 18 points against her former team, and the Golden State Valkyries relied on a second-half surge for an 80-66 win over the Minnesota Lynx on Monday night in Minneapolis.
